title: 长任务的单一生命周期所有者
summary: 耗时编码、构建或原生任务应由持久生命周期组件单独拥有；第二个正式任务必须拒绝或排队，所有终止路径都要由同一 owner 清理会话、临时资源和可观察状态。
invariants: One formal job has one lifecycle owner.
A second conflicting job is rejected or queued; it does not share the active native session.
Success, failure, cancel and timeout all execute explicit cleanup.
Activity/WebView/UI lifetime is not the owner of a long native job.
Progress is observable independently from the UI object's lifetime.
Interrupted-job staging is recoverable or explicitly cleanable on the next launch.
